audit: Terminal Company R2 product/build separation map

destination.name: 00 · Read me & Build contract · D07 Company

policy: Preserve node IDs and all product chrome. Execute no moves for held/archive rows. For two-child wrappers promote complete APP UI first, then original wrapper. For inline notes preserve original artboard; move note block alone. Product/source truths and source holds remain unchanged.
observations: 58 exact BUILD ONLY/BUILD NOTES headings matched file-wide. 55 are visible, unarchived candidates. 1 safety-held and 2 archived frames are display:none and excluded.
16 two-child wrappers contain a complete APP UI sibling and builder rail: 10 desktop 1960→1440 product widths; 6 tablet 768→768.

39 remaining cases retain the original product artboard. 4 phone build-sheet wrappers include additional product menus/state specimens; moving only the rail preserves these. 35 cases have builder text inside product content.
All 39 MOVE_BUILD_RAIL_ONLY subtrees were read as full JSX and contain the BUILD ONLY header + builder contracts only.
get_node_info.isVisible was true even for display:none roots; effective exclusions use computed styles and explicit hold/archive names.
Fixed-height roots may retain bottom space after removing notes; check layout separately. No source/production acceptance is implied.
